about:
Computer Cable Connection, Inc. (CCC) is based in Omaha, Nebraska, and was established in 1986 as a full-service BICSI and RCDD network cable design and installation firm. The company serves private, state, and federal institutions across the United States. No founder names or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

CCC provides a range of communications infrastructure services including structured cabling, fiber optic installation and repair, fusion splicing, testing, termination and certification, and custom cable assemblies built to specified length, color, and termination. The firm also designs and installs rack and cabinet layouts, cable management, UPS/PDU systems, distributed antenna systems (DAS), sound masking, audio/visual solutions, intercom and paging, and medical equipment installations. With over 30 years of experience, the company reports more than 30,000 completed projects and a network of 870-plus appointed contractors.

The client base spans commercial, government, and healthcare sectors, with explicit mention of medical equipment installation, federal and state institutions, and private enterprises. Projects have been executed in thousands of facilities nationwide.

CCC emphasizes a client-satisfaction process that moves from discovery and solution design through installation and switchover support. Technicians are trained and certified to manufacturer specifications and BICSI standards, and the company highlights its on-time delivery record and partnership approach with customers and suppliers.
